liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1987-03-24.140805.sbd.miller.flac2496** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 136 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1987-03-24.sbd.milller.94349.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 136 min; rated 3.43/5 by 7 [3]
- **gd1987-03-24.nak300.braverman.10077.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 130 min [9]
- **gd1987-03-24.163462.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 132 min [10]
- **gd87-03-24.schoeps.weber-small.gardner.10354.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 18 songs; 135 min; rated 4.3/5 by 10 [14]. Said about its sound: Loud cheering waves intensified progressively after lyrics, lasting until 9:45; Sound is muffled with overwhelming audience noise; vocals are hard to hear [23][34]
- **gd87-03-24.set2-sbd.miller.25581.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 77 min; rated 3.67/5 by 12 [21]

## Around the show

- Giant inflatable Godzilla danced above audience heads during the performance [23]
- Reviewer drove from New Jersey to Hampton, hitting a dog on the way [28]
- Jerry bopped around the stage and hammered big notes during the jam [30]
- Garcia attacked his guitar and pumped fists throughout the performance [30]
- Reviewer finds the placement of Black Muddy River very odd in the second set [33]
- Reviewer calls it the sickest Terrapin they ever experienced [24]
- Reviewer claims it is the best Terrapin they have ever heard [25]
- Reviewer believes it is the best version of any single song seen live [32]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-03-24.140805.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [1]. Also: Two sets of masters were used to make the show complete [1]
- **gd1987-03-24.sbd.milller.94349.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Cassette Set 2: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) [3]. Also: Dear Mr. Fantasy is a Schoeps CMC4/MK4 recording transferred to CD [3]
- **gd1987-03-24.nak300.braverman.10077.shnf**: transferred by Stephen B. Porter; Seeded to etree by Peter Braverman; source: AUD (Nakamichi 300/Sony D-5) [9]. Also: Crossfades placed in first set where crowd noise is missing [9]
- **gd1987-03-24.163462.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M [10]. Also: Nakamichi 104 source supplies crowd noise and beginning of Let It Grow [10]
- **gd87-03-24.schoeps.weber-small.gardner.10354.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB Schoeps CMC44 > Oade P.S. > Sony PCMF1 Sony PCMF1> DAT [14]
- **gd87-03-24.set2-sbd.miller.25581.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 2 Only - Recording Info: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) Transfer Info: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude v7.02 Professional -> SHN… [21]. Also: Recording is a matrix SBD from the Vault with heavy audience mix [29]
